note: The original's achievement ladder (E16). AchievementTaskType.json names 5 categories and 32 chain heads; TaskGeneral.json holds 4,145 A_task_* rows, each a step with taskReq {type,count} and a reward, linked by nextTask. Achievement.json is an EMPTY WRAPPER -- the rows really live in TaskGeneral, exactly the trap CLAUDE.md rule 3 warns about.
rewards: Every step pays crystals (reward item id 4) and, where present, gold (item id 3). Other reward items are NOT substituted: they are listed in unmappedRewardItems and pay nothing, rather than being approximated into something Everkai happens to have.

excluded.Top3Prosper: cross-server ranking; DATA-07 records rankings as fabricated server-side
excluded.Top3Intimacy: cross-server ranking; DATA-07 records rankings as fabricated server-side
excluded.ThiefGet: a timed event currency, not a permanent system, so nothing in Everkai can ever increment it
excluded.MovingTokenGet: a timed board event currency; the event does not exist in Everkai and no permanent system mints it
excluded.MovingLevelId: progress on a timed board event whose board Everkai does not ship
excluded.DragonDown: Drakenberg Challenge is not built yet (row B3)
excluded.MerchantTrader: Bazaar is not built yet (row B9)
excluded.SimGame1Score: the Inn is not scored in Everkai
excluded.TotalCharisma: no charisma stat exists in Everkai
excluded.Find: ambiguous: no single Everkai counter matches it
excluded.FieldTripNum: Field Trip is not built yet (row C12)
excluded.BuildingTotalStar: building stars are not modelled yet (row SL1-04)
excluded.EquipmentAtlas: gear atlas completion is not modelled
excluded.StageClear: DIFFERENT SHAPE, not a different number: these 190 rows carry taskReq {type,id} naming a stage ("5-6-0"), not {type,count}. Mapping a stage id to a cleared-count would be an invention, so the chain is excluded rather than approximated.
excluded.EquipCount: Everkai tracks gear per Fellow and in the bag but has no single owned-equipment count; building one to satisfy an achievement would be inventing a counter
excluded.Login: Everkai stores no login-day counter, and distinct habit days is a PROXY, not the thing -- a day played without a habit would not count
excluded.OrderSubmitCount: Everkai keeps no cumulative farm-order counter
